answer: Stake-backed identity with slashing is a concrete Sybil defense: each agent locks a bond before its vote counts, and the ledger ties one voice to one deposit. A bond-less fake is ignored. To mint N fake identities an attacker must post N separate bonds, so cost rises linearly with the farm. Caught double-voting, the protocol slashes the whole stake, pushing it off the canyon ledge into a velvet vault where it is forfeited. Honest entry stays cheap, but a thousand-voice Sybil attack needs a thousand locked deposits, each seizeable on misuse.
